lines: Attention, planet Earth! This is America. Number one country. As always.
The United Nations is officially... closed!
Closed? Like, for lunch? Sorry, I am just asking.
Forever, buddy. No more rules. Freedom!
Wait, amigo. No rules at all?
Uh... Mexico? Why are your eyes red?
HEY! That was a joke! A JOKE!
Too late, amigo. No more rules.
I am going to go hide now. Sorry. Sorry.
And that... is how the world ended. In about four seconds.
This is THE LAST NATION. Episode one. No more rules.
Right. Emergency meeting. This is most serious.
Another meeting? I hate meetings. This is unacceptable.
The meeting started at nine. It is nine and four seconds. You are late.
Mamma mia, everybody calm down! Who wants pasta?
Focus. The rules are gone. What is the plan?
The plan is simple. Nobody invades anybody. We are civilized. Not like America.
Agreed. Nobody in Europe invades anybody.
But Monaco is very small. And very close. And very rich.
FRANCE! WE AGREED TWO SECONDS AGO!
Do not shout at me! I am the victim here!
Then San Marino is mine! It is literally inside my boot!
Huh? What happened? Did I miss something?
Oh. Okay. Then... Portugal. And Andorra. Zzz...
He just invaded two countries in his sleep. Most unfortunate.
England! My oldest friend! Help me!
Terribly sorry, old chap. It is tea time.
We have been allies for six hundred years!
Zzz... welcome, Portugal... siesta is at three...
Namaste, everyone! India here. One point four billion people. Biggest country on Earth.
Pakistan, my friend. Now that there are no rules, I can finally say it.
My cricket team is better than yours.
THAT is what you do with no rules?!
Um... India? You two are shouting a lot. Can I hide behind you?
Me too, me too! I am very small!
Of course! Come inside. Protection is free.
Wait... did you just annex us?
I protected you. Very strongly. Forever.
He annexed two countries with a hug. Unbelievable.
You told the whole internet that rendang is Malaysian.
Guys! Guys! I am just a tiny city. Please. I sell phones.
Singapore. You are surrounded by me now.
Please, I have a very small army. Like, twelve people.
Oi! Indonesia! That is getting a bit close, mate!
Australia. How many people do you have?
I have two hundred and eighty million.
Yeah, but I have spiders. Big ones. In your shoes.
Fine. You win this one, Australia.
Sri Lanka! Maldives! Beach holiday with your big brother?
No thank you. I have tea. I am fine.
Actually India, I am slowly sinking into the ocean. Please take me.
I have so much land. Good luck finding a seat on the train.
Indonesia. You took Malaysia. And Singapore. And Brunei. Am I next?
Relax. You are my friend, Philippines.
Hey, I am just standing here!
You were standing too close, Papua. Bad luck.
Hello? China? It is me. America. The greatest country in the world.
Hello, America. It is an honor to hear from you. How is your family?
Uh... good. Listen. Stay away from my friends in Asia.
Of course. With all respect... which friends?
Very good friends. Very close to me. Very far from you. Respectfully.
Stop being so polite! It is creepy!
My apologies. By the way, I made your phone.
And your shoes. And your flag. Have a nice day.
Excuse me. One question for Europe.
Why does the whole world call them French fries?
YOU DID NOT! I INVENTED FRIES!
Actually, fries are American. Look at any menu.
America, shut up. Nobody asked you.
I just put mayonnaise on them. I stay out of this.
Belgium, this argument is so annoying. I am so tired.
You know what? Now you are French. Problem solved.
Ugh. And now I have to do the paperwork. Terrible. Unacceptable.
Netherlands! I am tiny and France is right there! Hide me!
Come here, little Luxembourg. Mayonnaise is safe.
Austria. Liechtenstein. Let us make a little union. I made a spreadsheet.
Neutral is not a country, Switzerland. It is a mood.
Ja, okay, sounds fun. Same language anyway.
Germany. Are you doing the thing again?
This is completely different. It is in the spreadsheet.
Germany. I am watching you. Very closely.
I have the biggest army in Europe now. Since last Tuesday.
I bought it online. Two hundred tanks. Free shipping.
And Lithuania! Remember when we were one big country?
That was four hundred years ago!
Noted. Poland is scary now. I will update the spreadsheet.
Hello India. I see you got bigger.
Hello Indonesia. You also got bigger.
I have the best food in the world.
No, I have the best food in the world.
Okay. Truce. China is getting very big, my friend.
Alliance. But my biryani is still better.
Russia?! Where did you come from?
I was always here. You just did not notice.
Okay, that is creepy. What do you want?
Alaska. I would like it back.
No way! I bought it fair and square! Seven million dollars!
Are those ships going to Alaska?!
Russia. I am right behind you. With a sauna.
Denmark. Sorry to bother you. We need to talk about Hans Island.
MY island. Sorry. But I left a bottle of whisky there!
And I left a bottle of schnapps. So it is mine.
Guys. The whole world is at war. You are fighting about a rock.
It is a very important rock, America.
Qatar. You have too much gas.
I hosted a World Cup! Everybody loves me!
Everybody was very hot. Nobody loved you.
Brother, relax. Let us buy a football club together.
I already have three football clubs. I want land.
Because I wanted to do that!
CYPRUS?! TURKEY, I WILL NEVER FORGIVE YOU!
Greece, you never forgive me anyway.
Right. Second emergency meeting. Who invaded whom?
Monaco and Belgium. And I am still complaining about it.
San Marino. It was inside my boot!
Austria and Liechtenstein. Everything is in the spreadsheet.
Zzz... huh? I have Portugal? Since when?
Oh, you want to talk about Brexit?!
Iceland! Norway! You love fish. I love fish and chips. Come here!
You cannot invade two countries for fish and chips! This is outrageous!
Watch me. I did it to half the planet once.
Huh? What? Gibraltar? Yes! Give it back!
Hello Spain. I am right across the water. I can see you.
Morocco, not now! I am very tired.
Spain. Touch Gibraltar and I will cancel your siesta.
India. Indonesia. An alliance against me? I am very hurt.
And Japan. And America behind all of you. As always.
I was so polite. So respectful. But okay.
Mongolia. Laos. Cambodia. Myanmar. Thank you very much.
HE JUST TOOK FOUR COUNTRIES AND SAID THANK YOU!
Okay! Everybody calm down! America is here! Number one!
My fleet is moving. Just a little. For freedom.
Thank you, America. Please park them over there. Carefully.
Um. Hello. Why is everyone looking at me?
I just wanted to make computer chips in peace!
My ships are just going for a walk. A polite walk.
Then my ships are going for a walk too! A freedom walk!
Two superpowers. Two fleets. One tiny island in the middle.
And the whole world is watching.
Guys... please... do not do this...
